hypotheses.mechanism: One candidate only: ridge on intercept, 24h log-return momentum, 24h realized hourly log-return volatility, and their one product interaction. No post-hoc regime threshold, feature search, or multi-horizon selection; volatility may predict scale rather than sign, so directional alpha is not presumed.
hypotheses.pre_origin_features: Require 25 consecutive hourly close values each independently first-observed before actual forecast publication. Set m=log(P_t/P_t-24), v=population_sd(log(P_j/P_j-1), j=t-23..t), interaction=m*v. These are feature definitions only, not as-of source attestations; exact model fit/feature scaling must be frozen before any permitted prospective fit.
hypotheses.falsification_rule: No model promotion unless independently witnessed prospective paired absolute log-price performance beats persistence, the additive ablation AND the regularization-matched Taylor placebo under prespecified dependence/multiplicity correction and complete missed-slot accounting; otherwise REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE. Historical hourly scores are exposed, not confirmation.
hypotheses.negative_control: Two PREDECLARED controls, fitted to identical source-approved training rows/ridge: (1) nested x=(momentum,volatility) without interaction, (2) dimension-matched additive Taylor placebo z=m*training_mean(v)+v*training_mean(m)-training_mean(m)*training_mean(v), fitted as x=(m,v,z) to detect fake ridge-penalty relief. Candidate must beat BOTH independently under the fixed comparison hierarchy; never choose a control after seeing results.
